rows.note: Use 本質 as the all-purpose noun for the inherent nature or core character of a thing or idea.

example.english: The essence of this matter is self-interest.
example.traditional: 呢件事嘅本質就係利益。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 bun2 zat1 zau6 hai6 lei6 jik1

rows.note: Use 香精 for a concentrated flavouring extract such as vanilla essence used in food or drink.

example.english: When making the cake, add a little vanilla essence.
example.traditional: 整蛋糕嗰陣加少少雲呢拿香精。
example.jyutping: zing2 daan6 gou1 go2 zan6 gaa1 siu2 siu2 wan4 ne1 naa4 hoeng1 zing1
